security_audit.summary: Most of the 400 static findings are false positives from test code, text entropy heuristics, Markdown, CSS, and safe argument-array subprocess calls. Confirmed behavior includes persistent browser and credential storage, plus HTTPS requests that send authorized queries and an API key to the configured trusted-search service. The workflow also automatically provisions or reuses a persistent third-party credential after user login. Static review was capped at 400/899 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 499 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Require an explicit confirmation immediately before creating or reusing a MaaS key. Identify the account, key scope, storage path, and revocation method in that confirmation.

remediation.issue: Persistent browser sessions and trusted-search credentials
remediation.suggestion: Keep credential files owner-readable only, provide a clear removal command, and document the retention period for browser profiles and sessions.

content.value_statement: AI answers can conflict or omit sources when decisions need reliable facts. This skill captures answers, compares claims, and creates staged reports with traceable evidence.
actual_capabilities: Collect answers, visible citations, screenshots, and page evidence from selected supported AI web platforms.
Compare one or more platform answers and identify consensus, conflicts, and uncovered claims.
Create a structured unverified comparison draft from atomic, checkable knowledge points.
Request authoritative evidence through the configured trusted-search service when the workflow requires it.
Generate separate capture, comparison, authority, and final performance reports.
Stop the workflow when capture, evidence, or review gates are incomplete.
limitations: It supports only the web platforms and page layouts included in the package.
Platform login, CAPTCHA, and browser changes can stop collection until the user resolves them.
Authoritative verification can require a trusted-search account and a locally stored API key.
A report reflects captured evidence and does not replace professional legal, medical, or financial advice.

use_cases.title: Compare vendor research answers
use_cases.description: Compare several AI answers to a market question before a product team uses them in planning.

use_cases.title: Review policy claims
use_cases.description: Preserve AI citations and verify disputed policy details before an analyst shares a briefing.

use_cases.title: Create an evidence package
use_cases.description: Produce a staged report package that reviewers can inspect after an AI-assisted research task.

prompt_templates.title: Check one answer
prompt_templates.prompt: Fact-check this question on one supported platform: [question]. Capture the answer and sources, then show the first report.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask [question] on [platform A] and [platform B]. Compare their key factual claims and pause after the comparison report.

prompt_templates.title: Verify disputed claims
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [question] across [platforms]. After I approve the comparison, use authoritative evidence only for claims that need verification.

prompt_templates.title: Run a full audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the complete fact-check workflow for [question] across [platforms]. Deliver every stage report and mark any unresolved claim for review.

output_examples.input: Compare two AI answers about a housing policy.
output: Capture report with both answers and cited sources.
Comparison report that identifies conflicting payment limits.
Authority report that marks each claim as supported, contradicted, or insufficient.

output_examples.input: Verify one AI answer about a product requirement.
output_examples.output: A single-platform evidence report that separates captured claims, available sources, and unresolved points.

best_practices: Start with the smallest platform set that can answer the research question.
Review the unverified comparison report before requesting authoritative verification.
Remove local browser profiles and credentials when the shared workstation no longer needs them.
anti_patterns: Do not treat an unverified comparison draft as a final factual conclusion.
Do not enter passwords, one-time codes, or API keys into the chat.
Do not claim completion when a capture or authority gate reports an unresolved state.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does every run need an API key?
faq.answer: No. Capturing and comparing answers do not require the trusted-search key. Authority verification can require it.

faq.question: Will the skill log in for me?
faq.answer: No. You complete passwords, verification codes, and CAPTCHA steps in the visible browser.

faq.question: What does the skill save locally?
faq.answer: It can save browser profiles, report artifacts, and a trusted-search credential. Review the privacy documentation before use.

faq.question: Can I compare one platform?
faq.answer: Yes. One platform supports capture and verification. Two or more platforms add consensus and conflict comparison.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The workflow marks the claim for review and must not present it as a completed verification.
